improvements: P6 fixed. Parameters named by calldata word (_param4 for the bytes in the three hook functions). Calls decoded: asset(), balanceOf, markets, delay(), withdraw, deposit, previewDeposit, isFrozen, approve, transfer, unknownd14cf301(caller). Custom errors decoded: NoBalance(), Unauthorized(), Timelocked 0x774ae17d, NotNext 0xfde5ed88, Disagreement 0xb06dad04, SafeERC20FailedOperation(address). swap and collectCollateral return values instead of raw memory. In executeProposal(s) the proposal type re-tested inside a known arm is folded, removing dead REDEEM/WITHDRAW arms and dominated Panic(33) checks (about 200 lines each). pluginManifest's 3 struct-array init loops are no longer rotated (P3). stor6/stor7 hashes show their contents. 524 fewer lines.
notes: Diff 5164 lines, reviewed by structure: per-function effects and control-statement diffs for all 13 changed blocks (storage, supportsInterface: hex padding only). Dropped Panic(33) checks verified dominated: the enum is required < 8 at decode (2495) and its arm fixes the value. 24 while blocks before and after (one renamed v -> w).
summary: One medium regression: exact free-pointer values printed in full make argument stores, return-data checks and call targets far longer (lines over 300 chars 11 -> 120). Otherwise clear gains: many calls and custom errors decoded, returns decoded, dead enum arms folded in executeProposal(s), struct-array loops un-rotated.
